heroIntro:
Free, open source and local.
No login, no uploads, no complex settings.
stageCaption: Add a video. Choose quality. Convert.
stageAlt: MP4Flow in English, showing a local video conversion
proofOneBody: Copies compatible video without re-encoding. Uses hardware acceleration when available.
proofTwoBody: A lightweight app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
proofThreeBody: Your videos stay on your Mac, from import to export.
toolsTitle:
Convert to MP4.
Make a few useful edits.
toolsIntro: Convert and combine clips, then fine-tune the picture. Eight useful tools, all on your Mac.
toolOneBody: Convert one video or a whole batch. Copy compatible video without re-encoding; use hardware acceleration when available.
toolTwoBody: Set the start and end points. Keep only the part you want.
toolThreeBody: Drag the frame or enter dimensions to remove unwanted edges.
toolFourBody: Turn video by 90° or 180° while keeping its proportions.
stepOneBody: Drop files in, or choose them in Finder.
stepTwoBody: Choose quality. Trim, crop, fix proportions or adjust the image if needed.
stepThreeBody: Follow the progress, then open your video in Finder.
downloadBody:
Download the latest version, or build from source.
Free, open source, and right on your Mac.
footerTagline: Simple video tools. All on your Mac.
pageDescription: Convert, merge and edit video on Mac. Trim, crop, rotate, fix proportions, brighten and lightly denoise. Free, open source and local.
socialImageAlt: MP4Flow, a native Mac video converter
installIntro: Homebrew installs both tools MP4Flow needs: FFmpeg and ffprobe.
installStepThree: In MP4Flow, select Environment Check → Recheck.
installHelp: No Homebrew? Install it first and complete its Next steps:
aspectBody: Fix stretched or squashed video without cropping away the picture.
editorGuide: Open Edit Video in the queue. Brightness and denoise are in Image Adjustments. Apply your edits, then start conversion.
adjustNote: Image adjustments require re-encoding and do not support HDR. Light denoise is off by default and may slightly soften detail.
mergeBody: Join unedited clips in queue order. Merge directly when compatible, or use Compatible Merge to match formats.
brightenBody: Adjust brightness and gently lift shadows. Preview the result as you edit.
denoiseBody: Reduce visible grain in dark scenes. Enable a light touch of noise reduction when needed.
